period.rule: A document or posting belongs to the reporting period if and only if period.start <= its timestamp <= period.end, comparing absolute instants (the UTC offset written in each timestamp must be honoured).

fx_rate_date_rule.description: The ledger is kept in the base currency. A foreign-currency invoice is translated at the fx.csv rate of the company-local calendar date of its posting; if that date has no rate (e.g. weekend), use the latest earlier date. Rows in fx.csv are dated at local midnight; rate = base major units per one foreign major unit.
fx_rate_date_rule.settlement: Cash received is translated at the rate of the payment date. Credit notes and payment allocations relieve receivables at the historical rate of the invoice they refer to; the allocation that settles an invoice completely relieves exactly its remaining base balance. The difference between cash and relieved receivables is posted to account 4900.

rounding_rule.unit: minor unit of the target currency

ledger_conventions.currency: All ledger rows are in the base currency; debits equal credits. Documents keep their own currency.
ledger_conventions.payments: A payment allocation is posted as a credit to receivables (1100) with the invoice_id; cash not applied to an invoice is posted to 2100.
ledger_conventions.documents: invoices.jsonl holds invoices and credit notes (CN-*, negative total_minor). An invoice dated outside the period without ledger postings is correctly excluded from this period.
ledger_conventions.references: Missing references are null (empty cell in ledger.csv).
